svg.title: The absolute-projection cosine transform hides odd harmonics and attenuates high even harmonics
svg.desc: For two circle densities one plus or minus one half cosine of eight theta, the angular density curves differ visibly, but their directional absolute projections differ by only two over sixty-three pi at most. A lower chart shows the exact maximum projection gap for frequency two n decays as one over four n squared minus one. All odd angular modes are completely invisible to absolute projections.
svg.text: Even modes fade as 1/n²; every odd mode is absent from absolute projections.
baseline g₀ = 2/π; plotted ordinate is (g − g₀) × 12,000
Largest projection gap for f± = 1 ± ½ cos(2nθ)
Fourier multiplier: 4(−1)ⁿ⁺¹ / [π(4n²−1)] · exact derivation and limits in note 23 · Lattice
